items.title: Algoriffix Pitch Perfekt v2 adds vocal transformation and four-part harmony
items.summary: Algoriffix has released Pitch Perfekt v2, adding Vocal Transformer and Functional Harmony to its voice-to-MIDI plugin and standalone app for macOS and Windows.
